scientific_integrity: A complete analytic proof is supplied, conditional only on the explicitly cited published compact-plus-scalar structural theorem for the AN closure. No independent audit or certification is claimed.

title: Exact three-level distances of Hilbert-space partial isometries to absolutely norm-attaining operators
